_readme: Central EOL stakeholder map. Process logic refers to ROLES only; people live in 'owner'. When a role changes hands, edit only that role's owner (name + email) here, through a PM Hub pull request. 'when': always | commercial (product EOLs and features with commercial impact) | product | feature. 'attendance': required (invited, must be free) | suggested (listed in the deck as a role to involve; invited only when the PM names the person for this EOL). 'owner': a fixed person, 'from_input' (the EOL owner from the PM's answers), or null (named per EOL).

roles.title: EOL owner (PM)
roles.why: Owns the EOL decision and plan, answers for the product, and is the escalation point for affected customers and deals.

roles.title: EOL process review
roles.why: Reviews the plan against the EOL governance requirements before execution starts.

roles.title: Product Operations
roles.why: Runs the EOL process: Asana tracking, communication requests and readiness checks.

roles.title: SKU & Pricing owner
roles.why: Retires the SKUs and price-list entries and approves any migration discount or bridge offer.

roles.title: R&D lead
roles.why: Owns the technical sunset: removal release, support window and technical impact.

roles.title: RevOps / Order Management
roles.why: Removes the SKUs from ordering systems and handles renewals of retired SKUs.

roles.title: Sales leadership / Deal Desk
roles.why: Handles open pipeline and renewals, and briefs the field on what to tell customers.

roles.title: Customer Success
roles.why: Identifies affected accounts and runs customer migration.
roles.why_feature: Needed only if strategic accounts actively use the feature.

roles.title: Support
roles.why: Sets the support policy until EOL and prepares for customer questions.

roles.title: Marketing / Customer Communications
roles.why: Owns the customer announcement through the External Communication Request process.

roles.title: Legal
roles.why: Confirms contractual notice obligations and approves customer-facing wording.

roles.title: Technical Writers
roles.why: Updates the documentation and publishes the EOL notice or What's New entry.
